SELECT
FROM group_buy_activity
AND group_buy_activity.del_flag = '0'
AND group_buy_activity.activity_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.activityName}, '%')
AND group_buy_activity.activity_status = #{query.activityStatus}
AND group_buy_activity.spu_id = #{query.spuId}
ORDER BY group_buy_activity.create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM group_buy_activity
AND group_buy_activity.del_flag = '0' AND group_buy_activity.activity_status = '1' AND group_buy_activity.started_at <= NOW() AND group_buy_activity.ended_at >= NOW()
ORDER BY group_buy_activity.create_time DESC
